CRE_Gith_Generic
Losiir is a githyanki fighter who replaces  Lae'zel's role in the Prologue while playing as her origin. Losiir has almost identical statistics and features to Lae'zel, but instead wields a scimitar and a longbow, and starts with the Defence fighting style.
“
Lae'zel - you still live! May the Queen's favour be yours.
„
— Losiir

Involvement

Prologue

When Lae'zel is chosen as origin, the player character encounters Losiir upon leaving the "brain room" on the Nautiloid, in the same manner that any other player character would first encounter Lae'zel. As a fellow githyanki soldier, he is more agreeable and trusting toward Lae'zel than she is toward other player characters she meets in this moment. He accompanies Lae'zel as a temporary companion through the rest of the prologue.

Losiir dies in the Nautiloid crash and his corpse lies bloodied on the beach. Upon seeing him, Lae'zel notes: "Losiir is gone. His spirit now swims the Astral Sea."

As Losiir is not a playable character, he cannot be revived with a  Scroll of Revivify. If he dies during the prologue, the Nautiloid's restoration must instead be used to resurrect him.

Loot

After the Nautiloid crashes, Losiir's corpse is on the beach, where it can be looted for:

  • Githyanki Boots
  • Githyanki Half Plate
  • Longbow
  • Potion of Healing - x2
  • Scimitar
  • Scroll of Revivify
  • Tourmaline Ring

Notes

  • Although Losiir is also infected with a Mind Flayer Tadpole, he is unable to commune with the illithid device trapping  Shadowheart to release her.
